title: I Logged Every Coworking Phone-Booth Minute the Founder Called Overflow

parts.text: I booked booth C at 11:02 a.m. and founder Clem was already on a call labeled overflow in the calendar. The door said: BOOK THE BOOTH. THIRTY MINUTES. END ON THE LIGHT. I was twenty-eight, member, holding a calendar hold. Clem did not stop. "Founders are the booth." I photographed the calendar, the hold, and his light on my time. Then I logged an overlap. At 11:09 the community manager asked why Clem's call was on my hold. I kept my voice indoor and let the timestamp talk. I have learned the difference between a title and a line item.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: The community manager can see Clem's live light on booth C during my hold.

social.video_title: The founder stayed live on my booked booth — Part 1/2
social.description: Coworking booth, a calendar hold, and a founder still talking. I logged the overlap. Would you have knocked?

parts.text: Clem called it overflow until the manager asked for the log. I printed the overlap, the photo, and the hold. He ended. Clem booked his own thirty and told members overflow was always about optics. Optics is a word founders use when lights exist. Booking now has a second line: FOUNDERS END ON THE LIGHT. I keep my thirty. Clem schedules. The booth finally sounds like a hold, not leftover air. I kept the printout in a folder labeled BORING. The rule looks ordinary now, which is the whole point.

social.description: Overlap log, ended call, and a second line. Was overflow ever my hold?
